History:

 Foreword
 As a child, Vinny was bullied because of his appearance and had few friends.  Minu defended Vinny from her childhood bully, Hwangyeon, the leader of the Ghost Crew.  Vinny later joined Minu and June as one of the first members of the Zephyrus Crew.  According to June, Vinny was a better rider than Minu.

 Vinny was raised by a single mother in poverty.  Her financial situation worsened because Minu's father opened a hypermarket next to her mother's private supermarket, which bears her name.  At some point in elementary school, he was trapped in a house fire and, in an attempt to save him, both he and his mother were hospitalized.  His mother's face received third-degree burns, resulting in a huge scar that covered half of his face.  His classmates, as well as the adults around him, gossiped about him and his mother, saying that he is some kind of albino or that he has a strange disease with a monstrous mother.  Vinny finally snapped when his bullies badmouthed his mother and began to fight back.  He became more aggressive and would freak out over every little thing instead of meekly enduring the abuse like he did before.  At school, he is beaten by teachers and often suspended for "ruining" the school's image.
